items: Pivot: Parametric colour matching replacing 3D LUT pipeline completely (no LUT, Hald, or .cube anywhere)
Proven reference match: linear-light 3x3 matrix, monotone tone curves, and 24-bin CIELAB hue-keyed selective stage (mean ΔE 4.88 / p95 11.40 vs identity 10.12 / 24.53 on Gojo pair)
Renderer Y-flip fixed: upright preview in all 8 view modes (Result, Wipe, Side by side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference, Channels, Scopes)
Scrolling ruler scrubber sliders: live uniform updates on touch move without lag or release-only delays; velocity fling decay and snap-to-round
Exact Keyflaw 1.4.9 effects: 14-pass Unsharp Mask, Sharpen, and Diffusion Glow using exact Keyflaw host contract and shader graphs
Letterbox bar auto-detect in CropEditorDialog using row threshold luminance analysis
Safe .kfpack export: SAF Storage Access Framework saving with application/octet-stream, read-back display name validation, and skill-compliant ZIP layout
Settings and privacy: explicit 4-row permission model with live status, fallbacks, and offline Android storage info card (zero INTERNET)
Keyflaw host renderer: native OpenGL ES 2.0/3.0 architecture executing Keyflaw shaders from assets/effects/ with FBO ping-pong
Honest Recreated and Heatmap: resolved target frame fallback bug in FitStage.kt; Recreated frame is genuinely generated from base pixels through the fitted 3D LUT lattice
3D LUT GPU sampling: half-texel corrected trilinear sampling over 2D strip texture matching CPU core within 1.5/255 with zero distortion
Real-time 60 FPS performance: zero CPU bitmap decoding loops in hot path; display-rate uniform-only slider updates and 300ms debounced persistence
Full 22 Keyflaw effect catalog: validated with 0 errors and 0 warnings against Keyflaw host spec; includes After Effects exact Unsharp Mask acutance and Sharpen Laplacian
Interactive Color Picker: HSV color canvas, hue slider, RGB/Hex inputs, preset palette swatches, and pixel-accurate eyedropper sampling directly from viewer frame
Automated verification: target-blind test proving Recreated does not depend on target frame once fitted, identity test (<1/255), and invert/channel-swap pixel tests
Complete overhaul of interactive UI: replaced all shell mockups and stubs with fully working controls
Source stage: real frame picking across Gallery, Video frame, Camera, and Files with local file copying, swap, crop editor, and fit gating
Projects list: real project deletion with confirmation dialog, recursive file cleanup, and Delete all projects in Settings
Tune stage: 8 active inspection view modes (Result with press-and-hold Before, Wipe with orientation flip, Side by side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference + gain, Channels, Scopes)
Stack editor: full 17-effect library picker, drag reordering, duplicate, delete, reset to defaults, undo/redo, and typed controls (slider, switch, dropdown, color)
Fit stage: foreground service look fitting with determinate 6-step progress, cancel, metrics (mean & p95 Delta E), and before/target/recreated/heatmap viewer
Export stage: seamless export to Downloads/MOTIONSALT/CC Studio/, pack collision resolution, and success sheet with Share and Open Keyflaw actions
Data & testing: built-in demo project generator with synthetic test charts, zero-stubs CI enforcement, and zero network permissions
MOTIONSALT CC Studio: 100% offline mobile Android color grading studio and Keyflaw 1.4.9 effect builder
Multi-stage color solver: 1D Tone curves, 3x3 chromatic matrix regression, and 3D residual lattice with Laplacian smoothing
True identity Hald Level 8 (512x512) PNG generation and 33x33x33 .cube LUT export with zero distortion
Real-time preview renderer with 8 inspection view modes: Result (with hold Before), Wipe, Side-by-side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference with gain, Channels, and live Scopes
Four live scopes: RGB Parade, Vectorscope, Histogram, and Waveform
Native Keyflaw 1.4.9 .kfpack exporter: single fused shader or full suite packaging directly to Downloads/MOTIONSALT/CC Studio/

17 built-in in-scope effects: 3D LUT, Brightness/Contrast, Exposure/Gamma, Levels/Curves, White Balance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Selective Color, Channel Mixer, Sharpen, AE Unsharp Mask, Clarity, Glow, Tritone, Haze Flare, Vignette, and Film Grain
